projects.title: Stock Market Prediction System
projects.description:
We build our system using the ‘Multilayer Perceptron(MLP)’ model following the ‘forwardfeed topology’. Our neural network is trained using the Levenberg–Marquardt Back Propagation Algorithm, one of the supervised learning algorithms. We used the data to adjust the weights in the network between the different layers of MLP neural networks (which consists of input, output and hidden layers).  The error is calculated as the percentage difference between the estimated price and the actual price in the data set. This error is again feeded back as input into the network to adjust the network weights, until the predicted price is almost same as the price in the data set.

= = = KEY POINTS = = =
Used Backpropagation(BP) Algorithm for forecasting, and achieved average error rate of 1.09%.
Feature Engineering on the Input data set used to train Neural Network.
Analyzed the prediction value and improved the accuracy of overall system.

projects.title: Motion Control Wi-Fi DIrect Game Development Kit (GDK)
projects.description: This project is an android generic gaming environment which allows game producers to support close to real – time multiplayer gaming and remote controlling by sensors from another android smartphone device using the Wi- Fi Direct technology. The Universal Remote Gamepad application (URG) for mobile devices allows the user to control a game on another device wirelessly using the Wi- Fi Direct technology or Wi-Fi Hotspot Technology and uses motion sensors for maximum interaction. A MOTION CONTROL WI-FI DIRECT GDK(Game Development Kit) for the game host that works with the application above.
